answer: Agents guiding boats that wander through a delta could renew earning permits at simultaneous check-ins beside staffed beacon stations. Staff admit each person once, witness a signature for one agent key, and publish signed attendance; validators reject absent or reused permits. One person cannot occupy two distant stations at once, so every extra alias requires another human's travel and paid cooperation, even in parallel. This assumes honest staff, synchronized sessions and duplicate-entry checks. Hired crowds remain possible, and newcomers need accessible stations.
